name: servers
sql: SELECT name, count() AS sessions FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(arrayConcat(McpServers, arrayMap(t -> concat(t, ' (CLI)'), mapKeys(ToolCounts)))) AS name FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}) GROUP BY name ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 8

name: total
sql: SELECT count() AS n FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
